caseName: Mississippi Power & Light Co. v. Mississippi ex rel. Pittman
caseNameFull: Mississippi Power & Light Co. v. Mississippi ex rel. Pittman, Attorney General

opinions.text: Application for stay of the Order Granting Mandatory Temporary Restraining Order and Setting Aside Chancery Court Order of June 18, 1987, issued by the Supreme Court of Mississippi on June 19, 1987, presented to Justice White, and by him referred to the Court, is hereby granted pending further order of the Court.
